title: Official I-010 sidecar acceptance: overlap path, unsupported-style loss report, and format goldens
aggregateCanonical: sha256 of sorted "digest  path\n" lines of sourceSha256
bounds: Checked-in SRT/VTT/ASS goldens under packages/studio_document/test/captions/formats/goldens/ officialize already-opened sidecar roundtrip of emoji, RTL, newline and non-frame times (SRT/VTT millisecond, including 101 ms; ASS exact centiseconds). Re-encoding matches the golden bytes; decode restores the same text and rational times. This is not a claim of lossless arbitrary ASS effects.

Unsupported ASS Style properties other than Name and Fontname are listed as ASS_STYLE_FIELDS_DROPPED. Unsupported Dialogue Layer other than 0, actor Name, per-event margins and Effect are listed as ASS_EVENT_STYLE_DROPPED. Existing ASS_STYLE_FONT_NOT_RENDERED, ASS_OVERRIDE_DROPPED, ASS_EVENT_DROPPED, WEBVTT_METADATA_DROPPED, WEBVTT_CUE_SETTINGS_DROPPED and SUBTITLE_MARKUP_DROPPED warnings stay. Those fields are not silently dropped and are not mapped onto the plain cue model or styleEffectId.

The already-delivered overlap policy stays a deterministic CAPTION_OVERLAP reject of intersecting half-open ranges; touching ranges remain allowed. Official paths are format decode (CaptionFormats.decode via CaptionImport/CaptionStore), the SDK persist path (importCaptions/SetCaptions), and the workbench import controls. An overlapping sidecar is refused as a whole file with no partial commit; cues that overlap already-committed project cues likewise leave the revision unchanged.

Already-delivered AssFontLayoutPolicy name fallback, declared script coverage, ASS_EXPORT_FONT_POLICY_REQUIRED, MANUAL_FIELD_LOCKED, CAPTION_RENDER_POLICY_NOT_IMPLEMENTED, caption-aware editor commands, and field-aware invert stay unchanged. Official InversePatch kind stays restoreSnapshot. This slice does not change production algebra, insertion order, or IMPLICIT_GAP, and does not claim deterministic shaping or lossless arbitrary ASS effects. Source-interval crop stays closed. I-005 and I-010 stay partial. This captions-side increment is C.3; Increment C.1 and C.2 evidence remain in evidence/caption-ass-export and evidence/caption-font-coverage-fallback.
